main_text.l: ciuit Atille aut. Ab infamia[?] et h[?]uerunt cũ et signe ꝯ[?] aquas misit: ut cũ potest. ¶ si quid potes, adiuua nos: mi[?]sertus ini. Ihus autē ait illi: Si potes credere, omnia possibilia sunt credenti. Et statim exclamauit pater pueri; cũ lacrimis clamabat: Credo Dñe; adiuua incredulitate mea. Et cũ videret ihs concurrere turbā, increpauit spiritui immundo dicens illi: Surde et muta, ego tibi precipio exi ab eo et amplius

page.notes: The leaf is a manuscript, not a printed page, with red initials and paragraph marks. The top line and the right edge are cut off, so many words are fragments and are marked [?] or left incomplete. Several abbreviations (ꝯ, ꝑ, Dñe) are uncertain. The transcription follows the visible letters only and does not restore the cut-off text from the Vulgate.
